title: Fits great, a little on the thin side
text: Fits great, a little on the thin side. Fits great, a little on the thin side, but I love the feel of it verses regular sheets.  It's not as cold to the touch as regular sheets and it's softer.  Not sure how long they will last or if it will pill or not.
